title: rosa × turbinata var. campanulata
intro: Rosa × turbinata var. campanulata, commonly known as the Campanulate Roses, is a type of hybrid rose plant that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in relieving stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Rosa × turbinata var. campanulata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant, and it should be used under the guidance of a healthcare professional.
